title: FlightAware Departure Delay Watch
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightaware:flight
| stats avg(departure_delay_min) as avg_departure_delay_min, max(departure_delay_min) as max_departure_delay_min by origin
| where avg_departure_delay_min>20 OR max_departure_delay_min>60
| sort - avg_departure_delay_min
description: Uses FlightAware flight status telemetry to monitor departure delay patterns by origin airport in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for airports that consistently eat away at travel margins, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest FlightAware flight status data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Origin table of average and max departure delay.
grandmaExplanation: It compares departure delay patterns by origin airport so you can spot airports that consistently eat away at travel margins before it becomes annoying.
